description: This file implements a fake Kubernetes container runtime for testing purposes, providing mock methods for container and pod sandbox management via gRPC.

classes.name: RemoteRuntime
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Kubernetes container runtime for testing, supporting gRPC server methods for container and sandbox operations.

methods.name: NewFakeRemoteRuntime
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new fake remote runtime instance with mock services and gRPC registration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the fake runtime server listening on the specified endpoint and sets runtime conditions to ready.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the gRPC server for the fake runtime.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns runtime version information.

methods.name: RunPodSandbox
methods.description: Creates and starts a pod sandbox.

methods.name: StopPodSandbox
methods.description: Stops a pod sandbox and reclaims resources.

methods.name: RemovePodSandbox
methods.description: Removes a pod sandbox, forcibly terminating containers if necessary.

methods.name: PodSandboxStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandbox
methods.description: Lists all pod sandboxes.

methods.name: CreateContainer
methods.description: Creates a new container within a specified pod sandbox.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a container.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container with a timeout.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container, forcibly if running.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Lists containers based on filters.

methods.name: ContainerStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a specific container.

methods.name: ExecSync
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously inside a container.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Prepares a streaming endpoint for executing commands in a container.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Prepares a streaming endpoint to attach to a running container.

methods.name: PortForward
methods.description: Prepares port forwarding for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ContainerStats
methods.description: Retrieves stats for a container.

methods.name: ListContainerStats
methods.description: Lists stats for all containers.

methods.name: PodSandboxStats
methods.description: Retrieves stats for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxStats
methods.description: Lists stats for all pod sandboxes.

methods.name: UpdateRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Updates the runtime configuration.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the overall runtime status.

methods.name: UpdateContainerResources
methods.description: Updates resources for a container.

methods.name: ReopenContainerLog
methods.description: Reopens the log file for a container.

methods.name: CheckpointContainer
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint of a container.

methods.name: GetContainerEvents
methods.description: Retrieves container events (stub implementation).

methods.name: ListMetricDescriptors
methods.description: Lists metric descriptors for monitoring.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxMetrics
methods.description: Lists metrics for pod sandboxes.

methods.name: RuntimeConfig
methods.description: Retrieves runtime configuration details.

methods.name: UpdatePodSandboxResources
methods.description: Updates resources for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down the internal gRPC client connection.
